responsibility: Defines the primary PowerPC VxWorks target configuration layered on the rs6000 ELF backend. It installs VxWorks/EABI predefined macros, forces big-endian operation, replaces the generic SysV4 specs with VxWorks-specific CPP/cc1/assembler/link/start/end/lib specs, derives required CPU preprocessor symbols from -mcpu, sets VxWorks defaults for ABI, processor, small-data and stack alignment, and enables VxWorks-specific profiling and stack-check behavior.
